>

  caseId,
  documentName: rawFile.name,
  documentType: 'مرفق',
  fileId,
  fileName,
  notes: '',

- `DELETE /announcements/:id` — deleteOne.

- `GET /announcement-documents/:announcementId` — `AnnouncementDocument.find({ caseAnnouncementId: ... })` sorted by `createdDate` desc.
- `POST /announcement-documents` — create.
